high_level_description: The image is a screenshot of a webpage from Google, specifically from the "Search Labs | AI Overview" section. The page discusses the Pygmalion effect, also known as the self-fulfilling prophecy. The text explains that positive expectations can lead to improved performance, while negative expectations can result in poorer performance. The webpage has a dark background with white and light gray text for readability. At the top, there is a navigation bar indicating the time (9:11) and various icons such as signal strength, Wi-Fi, and battery status.
